conviction_note: Nearly everything Q3 will carry was pre-released through six November press releases (USD 5M AstronauTx option income recognised in Q3, the 44.5 MSEK share sale and its small non-cash fair-value adjustment, tesofensine/Tesomet dropped, SAN2465 IND cleared, new CBO), so the findings sum to +0.1 and p_up sits at 52; abs_move_pct is 6.0 because this is a thin-coverage biotech whose last four Q-day reactions were 14.5/14.5/6.8/2.5% and whose call can still move timelines (SAN2668 Phase 1 start, Jazz USD 7.5M Phase 1 milestone), whose direction I cannot see.

findings.finding: Q3 will carry the USD 5M AstronauTx option income (recognised in the quarter) less a small non-cash financial-item write-down to the SEK 44.5M sale price, so the reported operating loss shrinks sharply from Q2's SEK -60.3M — but both halves were announced (10 Aug, repeated in the Q2 report, and 10 Nov).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No observed history on a one-off line for this name; estimated Q-day reactions were +14.5 (Nov 2025), -14.5 (Feb 2026), +6.8 (May), -2.5 (Aug 2026), cadence-estimated dates only.
findings.original_quote: I Sanionas delårsrapport för tredje kvartalet 2026 kommer aktieinnehavet att värderas till det överenskomna försäljningspriset. (Swedish twin of the English release: 'In Saniona's interim report for the third quarter of 2026, the shareholding will be valued at the agreed sale price.')
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: the company pre-announced both the income and the valuation. The only residual is a headline-reading retail reaction to a much smaller quarterly loss; if the market had not absorbed it the 10 Nov session (+1.5% on 2x volume) would have been larger.
findings.independence: Q2 report post-period note, a different document: https://storage.mfn.se/1c18e0a9-0968-4c36-8e3e-d712fc6f160f/20260827-saniona-q2-2026-uk.pdf

findings.finding: Tesofensine and Tesomet were removed from the pipeline on 23 Nov after Medix quit; the stock ROSE 4.8% (11.01 to 11.54 SEK) the next session on 1.39M shares, about 6x the 20-day norm, so the legacy-asset loss is absorbed and the report should carry no fresh negative on it beyond any small write-down.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Tesofensine regulatory news has moved this stock hard before (COFEPRIS non-approval Nov 2024); this time the reaction to its end was +4.8%.
findings.original_quote: Swedish twin of: 'Given the limited partnering interest and Saniona's strategic focus on its neurology and psychiatry pipeline, the company has decided to remove tesofensine as well as Tesomet from its pipeline.' (English text quoted from https://mfn.se/a/saniona/saniona-provides-update-on-tesofensine-collaboration-and-its-pipeline)
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: the tape shows the reaction already happened on 24 Nov (+4.8%, 6x volume). Filed so the next reader does not size it as a fresh negative.
